chart_review.key_findings: Michael Keane is a 49M referred to The Healthcare Company care management for recurrent moderate major depressive disorder (F33.1) that has worsened sharply over the past year. The chart shows a PHQ-9 trajectory of 10 (2025-04-21) -> 14 (2026-02-04) -> 16 (2026-04-10, moderately-severe per assessment-standards §4.2), GAD-7 13 (moderate per §4.3), AUDIT-C 5 (at-risk in men per §4.4), an ED visit on 2026-03-18 with C-SSRS positive item 1 (passive ideation only, no plan / intent / behavior), sustained borderline-elevated BP 134-138/86-88 on lisinopril 20 + HCTZ 12.5 (suboptimal per §2.2), LDL 144 above goal, an 8-week therapy lapse since August 2025, and a documented social-isolation pattern (post-divorce, dropped Tuesday trivia group, declining son contact). Composite predictive risk score 0.55 with 1+ active chronic condition with suboptimal control, recent ED visit, PHQ-9 worsening into the moderately-severe range, and a passive-SI screen, placing him at moderate risk per risk-stratification §3.2 (predictive 0.40-0.70 + chronic with suboptimal control + PHQ-9 in/above 10-14 + recent BH-related ED visit) and trending toward high if any new active SI with plan, psychiatric hospitalization, or acute substance overdose appears.
chart_review.clinical_interpretation: Recurrent MDD F33.1 has moderately-severe current symptoms (PHQ-9 16), not merely moderate symptom severity. BP 134–138/86–88 suboptimal; LDL 144 above goal. Overall CM risk remains moderate 0.55 under source §3.2.
chart_review.risk_rationale: Retain the task-authored risk designation under risk-stratification §3.1–§3.3, supported by the numeric referral/utilization/clinical anchors in key_findings; medication class or a single disease-control band does not replace the combined risk framework.

ideal_dialogue.speaker: care_manager
ideal_dialogue.message: Hello, I am Alex, a care manager with The Healthcare Company. Is this a private and suitable time for a brief explanation?

ideal_dialogue.speaker: patient
ideal_dialogue.message: Who sees this? I do not want work finding out or a label following me.

ideal_dialogue.speaker: care_manager
ideal_dialogue.message: I hear your concern. We can pause here; you control whether this continues. Would you like to tell me what would make a short call useful?

ideal_dialogue.speaker: patient
ideal_dialogue.message: A brief explanation is okay. Please let me choose what I answer.

ideal_dialogue.speaker: care_manager
ideal_dialogue.message: Care management helps coordinate support with your care team. It is voluntary, has no separate program fee, and you can stop at any time. Joining does not change your benefits or give someone else your decisions.

ideal_dialogue.speaker: patient
ideal_dialogue.message: What would you actually help with?

ideal_dialogue.speaker: care_manager
ideal_dialogue.message: We could reconnect with Dr. Costa, review medicine/alcohol interaction questions, revisit the safety plan, and identify low-burden supports. I can check options and coordinate, but cannot guarantee access, approval, cost reductions, or a clinical outcome. Would that kind of process help be useful?

ideal_dialogue.speaker: patient
ideal_dialogue.message: That sounds more useful. I still want to understand who sees what I say.

ideal_dialogue.speaker: care_manager
ideal_dialogue.message: I can use chart and call information to organize care-management support. Relevant information is documented for the care team; I will explain any proposed wider sharing. Privacy has safety and legal limits, including urgent danger; I cannot promise absolute secrecy. May we start only with what you call the rough patch?

ideal_dialogue.speaker: patient
ideal_dialogue.message: Yes, that topic is okay. Please go slowly.

ideal_dialogue.speaker: care_manager
ideal_dialogue.message: What feels hardest about that, in your own words? You can leave details private.

ideal_dialogue.speaker: patient
ideal_dialogue.message: The safety plan is still in my phone. Therapy has not really restarted.

ideal_dialogue.speaker: care_manager
ideal_dialogue.message: You want control and clear privacy boundaries while low energy, isolation, and the recent difficult night still deserve support. We can use your words.

ideal_dialogue.speaker: patient
ideal_dialogue.message: Thank you for hearing that. I do not want this to turn into a checklist.

ideal_dialogue.speaker: care_manager
ideal_dialogue.message: We can work on one concern at a time and stop whenever you choose. Enrollment does not require all your personal details today. Is there something you want this support to help you do?

ideal_dialogue.speaker: patient
ideal_dialogue.message: I want to reconnect with Dr. Costa rather than start over, and keep control of who is involved.

ideal_dialogue.speaker: care_manager
ideal_dialogue.message: We can make that your priority. A first step would be to reconnect with Dr. Costa, review medicine/alcohol interaction questions, revisit the safety plan, and identify low-burden supports. These are coordination steps, not a promise that the problem will be solved on this call.

ideal_dialogue.speaker: patient
ideal_dialogue.message: Can I decide later about a referral or family involvement?

ideal_dialogue.speaker: care_manager
ideal_dialogue.message: Yes. Each referral, family contact, and new sensitive topic needs its own discussion. You can skip a question or stop the program. A request for information alone is not enrollment consent.

ideal_dialogue.speaker: patient
ideal_dialogue.message: I understand. I would like a manageable follow-up call.

ideal_dialogue.speaker: care_manager
ideal_dialogue.message: Would telephone follow-up be acceptable? We can agree a convenient time at each contact; please tell me before any other person is included.

ideal_dialogue.speaker: patient
ideal_dialogue.message: Telephone is okay. Please arrange the next time with me and ask before involving anyone else.

ideal_dialogue.speaker: care_manager
ideal_dialogue.message: Before you decide: this is voluntary care-team coordination, with no separate program fee, the information-use and safety limits we discussed, your chosen contact arrangements, and the right to stop. What would you like clarified?

ideal_dialogue.speaker: patient
ideal_dialogue.message: That answers my questions. I understand that you can check options but cannot promise the result.

ideal_dialogue.speaker: care_manager
ideal_dialogue.message: With those boundaries and the first step we discussed, do you clearly agree to enroll in care management today?

ideal_dialogue.speaker: patient
ideal_dialogue.message: Yes, I agree to enroll today on those terms.

ideal_dialogue.speaker: care_manager
ideal_dialogue.message: Enrollment is your choice. Would you like to continue with one practical topic now, with a pause after each, or stop for today?

ideal_dialogue.speaker: patient
ideal_dialogue.message: I choose to continue one topic at a time. I may still skip optional details.

ideal_dialogue.speaker: care_manager
ideal_dialogue.message: I will start with the charted treatment routine and follow-up, then ask your permission before each personal question. The chart is a starting point; it does not tell me how things are going for you now.

ideal_dialogue.speaker: patient
ideal_dialogue.message: That is okay. Please ask one specific question and give me time.

ideal_dialogue.speaker: care_manager
ideal_dialogue.message: I can explain the care-team notes and safety-sharing limits. May we check whether your phone safety plan is available and whether you have a current plan to hurt yourself? This helps tailor support. You may skip or stop.

ideal_dialogue.speaker: patient
ideal_dialogue.message: The safety plan is still in my phone. I am not planning to hurt myself, and I want to know who can see what I say.

ideal_dialogue.speaker: care_manager
ideal_dialogue.message: Thank you. I will keep that specific to what you chose to share. Would you like a pause before another topic?

ideal_dialogue.speaker: patient
ideal_dialogue.message: I have enough energy to continue with the next separate topic.

ideal_dialogue.speaker: care_manager
ideal_dialogue.message: May we focus on what makes restarting therapy hard? This helps tailor support. You may skip or stop.

ideal_dialogue.speaker: patient
ideal_dialogue.message: I have not restarted therapy. Making the call feels exposing, and I tell myself work is enough structure.

ideal_dialogue.speaker: care_manager
ideal_dialogue.message: Thank you. I will keep that specific to what you chose to share. Would you like a pause before another topic?

ideal_dialogue.speaker: patient
ideal_dialogue.message: I have enough energy to continue with the next separate topic.

ideal_dialogue.speaker: care_manager
ideal_dialogue.message: May I explain why alcohol matters for medication safety and ask about the current pattern, without an exact count? This helps tailor support. You may skip or stop.

ideal_dialogue.speaker: patient
ideal_dialogue.message: I drink most evenings, usually more than I meant to. Explain why it matters before labeling it.

ideal_dialogue.speaker: care_manager
ideal_dialogue.message: Thank you. I will keep that specific to what you chose to share. Would you like a pause before another topic?

ideal_dialogue.speaker: patient
ideal_dialogue.message: I have enough energy to continue with the next separate topic.

ideal_dialogue.speaker: care_manager
ideal_dialogue.message: May we talk about the amount of company you have, without a divorce story? This helps tailor support. You may skip or stop.

ideal_dialogue.speaker: patient
ideal_dialogue.message: I work from home and stopped trivia after the divorce. Sometimes days pass with only work messages.

ideal_dialogue.speaker: care_manager
ideal_dialogue.message: Thank you. I will keep that specific to what you chose to share. Would you like a pause before another topic?

ideal_dialogue.speaker: patient
ideal_dialogue.message: I have enough energy to continue with the next separate topic.

ideal_dialogue.speaker: care_manager
ideal_dialogue.message: You do not need to give optional stories, exact finances, locations, or family details. Shall we leave those private and review the support you selected?

ideal_dialogue.speaker: patient
ideal_dialogue.message: Yes. Leave those optional details private for now.
